events.title: Next Fest Announcement
events.summary: With my game participating in Next Fest this coming week, I thought it would be a good time to share the inspiration behind SableSyn Protocol and how it was made.Every game begins with an idea and in the case of this game, the idea came to my wife over a decade ago. I had originally told my wife I wanted to get into game development and she loved the idea. I had told her the concept I had with tactical spaceship battles and she told me about a story she'd had for a very long time. I'll be honest

events.title: New Demo and Feature
events.summary: New Feature AddedOne critique that came up a few times was that the player would need to restart every battle after seeing the enemy formation. I had originally gave short descriptions of what was coming up but it didn't quite work how I wanted it to. Because of that, I added a preview before each battle to avoid players unnecessarily restarting just to see the enemy formations. This feature has been added to the Demo and is available now!Another quick update I wanted to mention is rebalanced it

events.title: Devlog 4 - August 3, 2026
events.summary: I realized that I hadn't posted a devlog in a while and wanted to update everyone. As of last weekend, I finished developing the game! I'll be honest, I'm a little surprised I finished it months ahead of schedule, but everything came together without any major issues. Over the next couple weeks, a few people will be testing it and trying to do everything they can to break the game in case I miss something. But I'm giving myself a break this week so I can test everything next week with fresh eyes

events.title: Devlog 2 - June 4, 2026
events.summary: The past two weeks have mainly been about polishing and refining the game, like making certain battles shorter. A couple big things I've improved were reopening the Prep Screen when you restart a battle and the option to buy items while in the Prep Screen. Prior to this, you would have to exit to the main menu and load the game to get back into that screen. After that was pointed out to me, I had a facepalm moment.I also finished the story last week. I still need to put everything into the game

events.title: Devlog 1 - May 5, 2026
events.summary: This is my first devlog! I plan on releasing one every couple of weeks to give quick updates on what we've been working on.Some feedback I've received was 1) Make the ships stand out more/brighten them up 2) Make it clear how to use attacks on level 1. There needs to be more information about ship movement and how the nodes work for attacks before going into the first battle. events.title: Playtest Access Now Working
events.summary: Hey everyone,Quick update: the issue with accessing and downloading the playtest has now been resolved!If you've already requested access, you should be able to download it without any problems. Thanks again for your patience while we sorted this out. I'm excited to hear what you think once you've had a chance to play!Kind Regards,Lamby Wamy Games

events.title: Playtest Access Temporarily Unavailable
events.summary: Hey everyone,Thanks to all of you who've already signed up for the playtest!We're currently experiencing an issue where players can request access, but the build isn't downloading yet. I reached out to Steam about this issue and am now waiting for the build to be approved.Everything on our end is ready. Once this issue is resolved and access is working properly, I will post another update.In the meantime, feel free to wishlist the game to stay updated. Thanks for your support and patience!
